item.title: NRC adjusts Abuja-Kaduna train schedule ahead of FCT elections
item.description: Ahead of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, Area Council elections scheduled for Saturday, February 21, 2026, the Nigerian Railway Corporation has announced a temporary adjustment to the Abuja–Kaduna train timetable. The change was disclosed in a statement issued by the Corporation’s Chief Public Relations Officer, Callistus Unyimadu. item.title: Kebbi govt condemns deadly village attacks, vows swift action
item.description: Kebbi State Government has condemned the recent attacks on several communities in the state, describing the incident as tragic and vowing to intensify efforts to safeguard lives and property. The attacks occurred on Wednesday in villages within Arewa Local Government Area, particularly Bui and neighbouring settlements. item.title: NSCDC warns against vandalism of fibre-optic cables in Zamfara
item.description: Zamfara State Command of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, NSCDC, has warned that it will no longer tolerate the vandalism of fibre-optic cables and other critical infrastructure across the state. item.title: Borno pays N2.5bn annual fees for students at Isaac Balami University
item.description: The Borno State Governor, Prof. Babagana Umara Zulum, on Thursday unveiled successful candidates for the state government scholarship to study at Isaac Balami University of Aeronautics and Management (IBUAM), Africa’s first indigenous aviation university. The governor also presented a cheque of N2.5 billion to the institution as payment for the beneficiaries’ annual school fees. item.title: Again, fire guts another Kano market
item.description: An early morning fire outbreak has ravaged no fewer than 50 shops at the Fatima Simra Multi-Purpose Market in Dakata area of Kano State. According to report, the inferno started around 5:40am on Friday. The incident comes barely one week after a major fire incident affected over 1,000 traders at Singer Market. Daily Trust reports […] Again, fire guts another Kano market

item.title: Police disburse N20m to families of fallen officers in Borno
item.description: Borno State Police Command has disbursed N20,137,770.34 to nine beneficiaries under the Group Life Insurance Scheme, supporting the families of officers who lost their lives in the line of duty.
